title: Proof run attested
description: A proof run at a commit is attested; the gates read it.

title: Change judged
description: A change got its verdict.

title: Release judged
description: A release commit got its verdict; release qualification reads it.

title: Modules resolved
description: go.mod and go.sum hold the service's resolved modules.

title: Module cache downloaded
description: A module cache for one source revision is ready for offline builds.

title: Application built
description: A service's executable was built and recorded, so it can be imaged and checked.

title: Image built
description: An image of a built executable exists locally with its record.

title: Image signed
description: An image and its SBOMs carry a keyless signature.

title: Image published
description: A signed image is in a registry, ready to deploy.

title: Component digest superseded
description: A platform engineer declared a successor for a component digest.

title: Component digest withdrawn
description: A platform engineer withdrew a component digest.

title: Compiler release qualified
description: Every required job and signed artifact at one commit passed.

title: Published compiler release verified
description: The published release matched its qualification, as a consumer installs it.

title: Compiler installed
description: An operator put a verified compiler in place.

title: Platform requirements written
description: A service's platform requirements changed; the platform reads them to prepare its environments.

title: Delivery pipeline written
description: A service's CI file changed.

title: Kubernetes base written
description: A service's Kubernetes base changed.

title: Delivery object written
description: A service's delivery object changed.

title: Delivery candidate passed
description: An image passed every STEGO check and may be released for delivery.

title: Fill scaffolded
description: A new fill and its test were written for one slot and collection.

title: Fill tests passed
description: A fill's tests passed, and its evidence was recorded.

title: Fill signed off
description: A person signed a fill's evidence.

title: Service build applied
description: Apply wrote a service's generated files and its new record together. Other domains learn from it what the service is built from.

title: Interrupted apply recovered
description: Recovery completed an interrupted apply, and the files and the record agree again.

title: Plan saved
description: A plan was saved under .stego/, and apply can carry it out.

title: Component added
description: A new component is in the registry.

title: Component version released
description: A component has a new version, so services built from the old version can be told.

title: Active registry composed
description: The sources of the active registry are pinned, and their parts are one active set.

title: Experimental component introduced
description: A component that is not ga is in the registry until its sunset.

title: Component graduated
description: A component moved up the maturity ladder.

title: Component withdrawn
description: A component is no longer in the registry, so services built from it can be told.

title: Archetype curated
description: An archetype has a new set of components and default providers.

title: Mixin added
description: An archetype accepts a further mixin.

title: Port defined
description: A port and the meaning of its fields are in the registry.

title: Slot declared
description: A component offers a new slot.

title: Quality evidence recorded
description: A component version holds a new piece of ga quality evidence.

title: Component promoted
description: A component written in a team's local registry entered the common registry, so every team can build from it.
